title: TrustGuard AI
tagline: A decentralized AI security protocol that analyzes, verifies and safeguards users' transactions.
description: TrustGuard is a decentralized AI security protocol for Ethereum that evaluates transactions and autonomous-agent actions before execution. AI models analyze transaction behavior and risk, Chainlink provides verifiable external context and workflow orchestration, and Ethereum smart contracts enforce the resulting security policy.
how_its_made: The user connects an Ethereum wallet such as MetaMask. TrustGuard establishes the information required for transaction analysis. The user or AI agent proposes a transaction. TrustGuard extracts relevant information. Independent AI workers analyze the normalized transaction. TrustGuard calculates an aggregate risk score. Chainlink infrastructure provides relevant external/on-chain context and orchestrates the risk-evaluation workflow. The TrustGuard policy engine determines whether the transaction should be approved, reviewed, or blocked. The risk assessment is recorded onto the Ethereum Protocol, creating an immutable security audit trail.
auto_summary: A concept-level Ethereum security project that records AI-derived transaction risk assessments and policy decisions onchain.
